chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from al-Ṣaffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ṣafwān, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The qurʾ cannot be less than ten; whatever exceeds that, the least that it may be is ten, from the time she becomes pure until she sees blood.

key_terms.أَقَلَّ: the minimum or least possible amount
key_terms.الدَّمَ: blood seen by the woman in this ruling context
key_terms.الْقُرْءُ: the menstrual interval or cycle referred to in this legal context
key_terms.تَطْهُرُ: she becomes pure from prior blood
key_terms.عَشَرَةٍ: ten days, the minimum period specified in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum period of purity between two instances of blood according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the minimum period of purity between episodes of blood. It establishes that the interval from the time a woman becomes pure until she next sees blood cannot be less than ten days.
